stations.title: Iain's pack
stations.text: Anyone adds to it, and nobody weighs it

captions: At the base, Dougie asks what Iain is carrying up the hill tonight.
Today anyone adds one more thing, and Iain's pack goes far over his limit.
You write the pack's methods: add, weigh, take out, and a copy without one item.
Now an item that would take the pack over the limit is refused when it is added.
Every pack knows its weight and keeps its own rule, and a copy changes nothing else.
